name: Football League Match - Men's vs Coventry
description: Watch the Loughborough Men's Football team take on Coventry in a thrilling league fixture. Come support the team and enjoy elite-level football.

name: Badminton Club Training Session
description: Open training session for all skill levels. Improve your technique and join our thriving badminton community.

name: Pottery Workshop - Begin with Clay
description: A beginner-friendly pottery workshop led by professional ceramicists. Create your first clay piece and explore sculptural techniques.

name: Volleyball Club Social & Newcomers Welcome
description: Meet new members and current players over refreshments. Learn about our club structure and upcoming fixtures.

name: Guitar Circle Open Session
description: Bring your acoustic guitar and join our relaxed circle to jam and meet other musicians. All levels welcome.

name: Meditation & Mindfulness Evening
description: Guided meditation session to reduce stress and improve mental clarity. Perfect for exam preparation or general wellbeing.

name: Rugby Union Training - Open to All
description: Structured training session for all abilities. Learn fundamental rugby skills in a supportive environment. No experience necessary.

name: Film Society Screening - Classic Cinema
description: Monthly screening of a classic film followed by informal discussion. This month: a cinematic masterpiece from the 1980s.

name: Squash Court Booking & Lessons
description: Book individual or group lessons with qualified coaches. Improve your game in a competitive but friendly setting.

name: Pottery Workshop - Wheel Throwing Intermediate
description: Progress to the pottery wheel. Learn centering and shaping techniques in this intermediate-level session.

name: Yoga & Flexibility for Athletes
description: Sports-focused yoga session designed for athletes of all disciplines. Enhance flexibility and prevent injuries.

name: Cycling Club Weekend Ride Planning
description: Plan upcoming weekend routes and social rides. Suitable for road cycling and mountain biking enthusiasts.

name: Life Drawing Class for Beginners
description: Explore figure drawing fundamentals with live model sessions. No previous art experience required.

name: Aqua Aerobics - Full Body Workout
description: High-energy water-based fitness class. Low-impact cardio workout suitable for all fitness levels.

name: Wellbeing Workshop - Sleep & Recovery
description: Expert-led session on optimising sleep patterns and recovery techniques for students and athletes.

name: Jazz Ensemble Rehearsal (Open to Observe)
description: Observe or participate in our jazz ensemble as we prepare for upcoming performances.

name: Judo Training & Progression Sessions
description: Traditional judo training for all grades. Work towards belt progression with experienced coaches.

name: Social Baking Night - Freshers Bonding
description: Bake sweet and savoury treats while getting to know other freshers. No baking experience needed!

name: Tennis Tournament - Singles Draw
description: Friendly singles tournament for competitive players. Multiple skill categories. Sign up before November 7th.

name: Spin Class & Cycling Fitness
description: Early morning high-energy spin class to kickstart your day. Indoor cycling with motivational coaching.

name: Muay Thai Club Training
description: Learn authentic Muay Thai techniques from certified instructors. All levels welcome; protective gear provided.

name: Photography Walk & Portfolio Review
description: Guided photography walk capturing campus landscapes. Includes informal portfolio feedback from experienced photographers.

name: Mental Health First Aider Training
description: Accredited training course to become a Mental Health First Aider. Learn to support peers during challenging times.

name: Digital Art & Design Workshop
description: Introduction to digital illustration and graphic design. Bring your own laptop or use lab computers.

name: Rowing Team Information Session & Taster
description: Learn about competitive rowing. Meet team members and experience a taster session on the water or ergo machines.

name: Wellness Retreat - Outdoor Nature Walk
description: Guided nature walk focused on connecting with the outdoors and reducing stress. Suitable for all fitness levels.

name: Kickboxing Class - High Intensity
description: Fast-paced kickboxing workout combining cardio and technique. Bring hand wraps and come ready to sweat!

name: Pottery Open Studio Session
description: Open studio time to work on your own pieces or experiment. Tutors available for guidance.

name: Badminton Tournament - Doubles Competition
description: Friendly doubles tournament for intermediate and advanced players. Team up or find a partner at signup.

name: Mental Health Matters Panel Discussion
description: Speakers from counselling services and peer support share strategies for managing student mental health.
